@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@3000@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@{{{speed}}}@@casttime@@0.25@@cost@@100@@cooldown@@120 / 110 / 100 / 90 / 80@@targeting@@Unit@@damagetype@@magic@@spellshield@@Special@@projectile@@true@@notes@@ * ''Unleashed Power's'' effect takes place at the start of the cast time. ** Additionally, ''Unleashed Power'' cannot be interrupted by any means, including death or [[File:Revival icon.png|20px|link=Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|An icon representing the keyword Resurrection]] [[:Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|resurrection]]. ''Unleashed Power'' will complete its effect so long as '''Syndra''' has initiated its cast. * Casting ''Unleashed Power'' on a target that becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] while the ''spheres'' are in flight will not destroy them but will invalidate their effects. * ''Spheres'' already in flight will still travel if '''Syndra's''' target dies, but any remaining ''spheres'' will not. However, their duration will still get reset. * A ''sphere'' summoned very shortly before ''Unleashed Power'' '''will''' be used as one of the spheres that get thrown. ** Depending on how many ''spheres'' are on the map and how far away the enemy is upon casting ''Unleashed Power'' it is possible that '''Syndra''' would conjure the ''sphere'' behind her as if she was going to throw it, but she won't. * ''Unleashed Power'' will not add a ''Sphere'' that '''Syndra''' is holding with [[File:Syndra Force of Will.png|20xpx|border|link=Syndra#Force of Will|An icon for Syndra's ability Force of Will]] [[Syndra#Force of Will|Force of Will]]. * ''Spheres'' that are being pushed by [[File:Syndra Scatter the Weak.png|20xpx|border|link=Syndra#Scatter the Weak|An icon for Syndra's ability Scatter the Weak]] [[Syndra#Scatter the Weak|Scatter the Weak]] (normally ones that were made late during the push) will not get picked up for ''Unleashed Power''. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will only block the damage of a single ''sphere''.@@
